tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog lha lnga'i cho ga snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga'i sgrub dkyil snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// de la 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i sngags pas nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ni gsum/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa dang bsdu rim gyi mthar thug pa sgom pa dang*/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag dang slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa rgyud nas bshad cing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bris sku bkram pa'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams/ nang mchod rdor dril la sogs pa'i yo byad 'du byas la stan bde bar 'dug ste/ rang nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/ ces mos la/ nang mchod/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang gi dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ shar du oṃ las dri chen| byang du khaṃ las klad pa/ nub tu aṃ las byang sems/ lhor trāṃ las rak+ta/ slar yang dbus su baṃ las sha chen/ shar lhor lāṃ las ba glang*/ lho nub tu yāṃ las khyi/ nub byang du pāṃ las glang chen/ byang shar du tāṃ las rta'i sha rnams rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros rdzas yi ge dang bcas pa zhu zhing khol bas nyi ma 'char kha lta bu'i kha dog can de'i rlangs pa las grub pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po mgo thur du blta ba lhung zhing 'dres pa'i steng du/ oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ

ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa yongs su gyur pa las oṃ āḥhūm̐ brtsegs te gnas pa las dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams spros/ 'gro ba'i don byas snyoms par zhugs pas yi ge gsum la thim/ yi ge gsum yang zhu ba thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis lce thog tu bzhag la myang*/ sngon gtor gong ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ pheṃ/ gtor mgron 'jig rten pa rnams spyan drangs phyogs mtshams su 'khod par gyur/ rdor thal kha phye la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ un+mā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā| gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*| |zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin stsol/

/dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*| |'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod// ces phrin las bcol/ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod rnams su hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal| dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag med kyi bde ba bskyed nus pa'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ= ā tsa mā naṃ= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= puṣ+paṃ= dhū paṃ= ā lo kaṃ= gan+dhaṃ= nai wi d+yaṃ= shapad= zhes sbyar la byin gyis brlabs// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sogs mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum po thams cad dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// bdag nyid chen po rnams dang ni// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni he ru kar gyur cing*// sems can thams cad he ru ka'i// go 'phang mchog la 'god par bgyi// zhes gsum gyis skyabs sems bya/ shrī he ru kaḥ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid| |ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste// ka ni gang du yang mi gnas pa'o// sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i rgyur shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ sngags gsum brjod/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i lte bar/ oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/

l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum brjod la/ yi ge'i phreng ba g.yon skor rim pa gsum du gnas pa las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros/ bgegs thams cad bskrad cing bcom nas slar yang sngags phreng la thim par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /ces dag pa gsum dang tshangs gnas bsgom/ g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis se gol phyogs bzhir gtog cing*/ shar du oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang du oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub tu oṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa| lhor oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi yi ge rnams nag ljang dmar ser ba'i kha dog can tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du khyab cing 'bar ba| de'i 'od zer las grub pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi pa phyogs kyi mdog can kyang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar du thug par mtho ba grub pa dang lhan cig /'og tu hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang*/ hūm̐ de'i 'od kyis steng dang 'og kun tu rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can gyi mda'i dra ba dang*/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i gur dang*/ ra gur gyi mtshams su rdo rje'i bla bre dang*/ phyi rol tu rdo rje'i me dpung 'bar bas bar med du khyab par gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pra kā ra hūm̐ paṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañdza ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su rang he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bla ma dang*/

bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*// rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi// rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud// phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la bzhugs pa'i// mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang*// dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi la 'dud// gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing*// 'du dang dur khrod gnas pa yi// dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma// kun la bdag ni gus phyag 'tshal// zhes phyag bya/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur| pi wang ma dang gling bu ma// rdza rnga ma dang rdza rnga che// sgeg mo bzhad mo glu gar mo// me tog ma dang spos 'chang ma// mar me ma dang dri chab ma// me long ma dang ro 'dzin ma// reg bya ma dang chos ldan ma// nam mkha' gang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra waṃ she huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa| oṃ badz+ra mṛ taṃ ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mu rañdze huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hā s+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pa badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ra sa badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ spar+she badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sbyar/ snying ga nas spros pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bzhis sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa thogs nas mchod par gyur/

oṃ sarba badz+ra kā mi nī barmā bhak+ṣaṃ sho dha ya gu h+ya badz+ra ni swā hā| zhes bdud rtsi dbul/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams bcom ldan 'das ma la thim yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ oṃ shrī ma hā su kha he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes 'khyud tshul bya/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*| |sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces gsum gyi rgyun bshags bya/ yig brgya brjod la/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur bar mos/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa med la kun rtog gis brtags pa tsam gyi sgyu ma lta bur gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis brtan g.yo thams cad sbyangs te 'od du gyur pa rang la bsdu zhing rang yang stod smad nas 'od du gyur pa thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de yang zhabs kyu/ khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ nā da yang shin tu phra ba mi dmigs par gyur/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ chos thams cad rab tu gnas pa med pa nam mkha' dri ma med pa lta bu'i 'od gsal du gyur/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa ste/ 'chi srid sbyong byed do// de ltar snang ba thams cad bsdus pa'i stong pa nyid las langs te/ rang gi sems nā da phra mo'i gzugs kyis nam mkhar gnas par gyur/

bar srid sbyong byed do// stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du yaṃ las rlung dkyil sngon po gzhu lta bu rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu dkyil dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa dkyil ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i lhun po gru bzhi pa lcog brgyad kyis mdzes pa'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma so gnyis pa'i ze'u 'brur hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa phyogs bzhi dmar zhing ge sar dang me rlung ser po/ lte ba dang bden bral ljang gu/ dbang ldan nag po'i mdog can gyi lte bar mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ dkar po phrag gnyis g.yas g.yon du bskor ba yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar po me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi steng du dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ḍa ḍha da dha ya la dmar po phrag gnyis g.yas g.yon du bskor ba yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dmar po mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de dag gi bar du nā da zhugs pa las thig le nas ū yig gi bar rim gyis grub pa'i hūm̐ yig rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas lhar byas pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams lhan cig spyan drangs/ snyoms par zhugs pas zhu ba hūm̐ gi nā da la thim pas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/

zla ba dkar dmar hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa dus gcig tu grub pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// skye srid sbyong byed do// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes skad cig ma'i sngags gsum brjod/ de yang rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang chen po gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa phyi nas/ dkar/ ser/ dmar/ ljang*/ sngo ba'i rtsig pa lnga ldan gyi steng du gser gyi pha gu rin po che sna tshogs pas spras pa/ de'i steng du dra ba'i snam bu la gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas mu tig gi do shal phyed pa 'phyangs pa/ de'i phyi ngos su bya 'dabs las 'phyang ba'i shar bu dkar po/ de'i steng du pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi mda' yab dkar po la gnas pa'i gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan gyis brgyan pa/ 'dod snam dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ phyi nang gi grwa dang sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rin chen rdo rjes mtshan pa/ sgo bzhir ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig pa'i steng du pad+ma chos 'khor gdugs dang bcas pa'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo/ khyams su bum bzang las thon pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing rin chen bdun dang ldan pa/ de dag gi phyi rol tu bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ye shes kyi me ri dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i bkod pa dang ldan pa'o// gzhal yas khang gi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud la gri gug gi phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i mthar ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i thog gi rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/

nang gi steng 'og thams cad shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba/ pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i sku can/ du ba dang mun pa'i mdog lta bu/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan mnga' ba/ ral pa spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor nor bu/ mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje| g.yon du zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis 'jigs dus kyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i pang du yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo| zhal gcig /spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud/ gcer mo skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas mdzes shing thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ zhabs g.yon yab kyi g.yas dang lhan cig tu brkyangs shing g.yas yab kyi sked la 'khril ba/ bde ba'i nyams can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o// 'dab ma shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer mo skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas mdzes shing thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'chang ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ ces rim gyis gsal btab la/ gong ltar skad cig ma'i sngags gsum brjod/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o// tshor ba dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni lā ma'o// chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni dum skyes ma'o// sems dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o// yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka'o// zhes byang phyogs kyi dag pa bsgom/

lha thams cad kyi dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ yab gyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣaṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su huṃ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang gu/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon po/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar po/ mgo bor hriṃ hrīṃ ser po/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ ces go cha bgo/ 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du gyur/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pad kor 'khyud rgya dang bcas nga rgyal bzung*| dbang gi lha rnams nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar| |lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas lha thams cad bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur/ chu lhag ma las yab la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan dbang lha rnams gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

sogs dang*/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi dbul zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma rnams dang mchog gsum kun 'dus pa'i// sku gsum ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa// mtshungs med bla ma mchog gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang dang klu sgrub dril bu pa| |dzā lan+dha ra nag po spyod pa dang*// til+li pa dang nā ro kar+ṇa ri// rdo rje gdan pa 'jigs med 'byung gnas zhabs// rtswa mi rga lo dpal ldan phag gru pa// chos rje spyan snga bcu gnyis dbang bsod pa// grags pa shes rab tshul rgyal grags rdor ba// blo bzang rin bzang bsod nams bkra shis dang*// rje btsun rat+na chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs// rdo rje 'chang dngos chos kyi grags pa sogs// dngos grub rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha so so'i snying po'i mjug tu 'bru gsum btags pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐| gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dam pa ye shes chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkar phyogs skyong ba'i 'jig rten pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyang bdud rtsis tshims nas zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang bar gyur cig /oṃ a mṛ ta swā da swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi rang gis kyang myangs/ yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan zhing bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru as mtshan zhing bde ba 'bab pa'i rtsa hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba rim gyis brtsams shing lhan cig skyes ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bar gyur/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes rjes chags kyi nga rgyal bzung zhing bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag go// oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ yab kyi snying po'o// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ| yab kyi nye snying ngo*// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum gyi snying po'o// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum gyi nye snying ngo*// oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ| oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i snying po'o// zhes lha so so'i sku la dmigs nas brjod/ de nas rdor dril dang bcas nas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā kalpāg+ni saṃ ni bha ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dzā ṭa ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ daṃ ṣ+ṭ+wā ka ra lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa ra shu pā shod+yā ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ byā gh+rā dzi nāṃ wa ra dha rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā dhū mrān+dha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces yab kyi rkang brgyad dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra wā rā hī baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lokya mā te ma hā bīd+ye shwa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha yā wa he ma hā badz+re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa sh+yaṃ ka ri ni tra bh+rā ma ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni s+t+wam+bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum gyi rkang brgyad do// zhes bstod/ thabs kyi yan lag rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad gsal la rdzogs pa/ shes rab kyi yan lag de thams cad gdod ma nas skye ba med pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du shes par byas la yun ring du bsgom pa ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// rang he ru kar gsal ba'i sku'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal ba'i spyi bor haṃ dkar po/ mgrin par oṃ dkar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar āḥdamar po de las gtum mo'i ye shes kyi me 'bar bas yi ge gsum bsregs/ haṃ las byang sems bab pas yi ge rnams gsos te bde drod 'bar bar bsam zhing*/ rlung kha sbyor du bsgoms la du ba la sogs pa'i rtags mngon du bya ba rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// skyo na bzlas pa bya ba ni/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi nga rgyal gyis sngags phreng rang gi zhal du zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar song ba sku'i dbyibs brgyud zhal nas thon rang gi zhal du zhugs thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim zhing*/ slar yang hūm̐ gi nā da las sngags phreng thon te 'khor bar gyur/ ces dmigs la yab yum gyi sngags bzla/ 'khor so so'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ la bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las lha tshogs spros 'gro ba'i don byas slar yang hūm̐ la thim par gyur ces 'khor gyi sngags bzla/ sngags ni bshad zin to// de nas thun bsdu ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis snang bar byas te srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang la thim/ de mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la/ de yum la/ yum yab la/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de yang zhabs kyu/ khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da'i bar 'dus te/ nā da yang mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur ces bsgom/ thun las ldang ba'i tshe/

slar yang rang nyid sgyu ma lta bu'i he ru ka dpa' bo gcig par gsal ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ snying gar oṃ ha sogs kyis go cha bgo// g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis se gol dang bcas/ oṃ suṃ bha sogs kyis bsrung*/ 'chad 'gyur gyi gtor ma dang smon lam bya/ zas kyi tshe lus lhar gsal btab la/ kha zas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥs byin gyis brlabs/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mos nas/ oṃ sa ma ya shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥs ma ya shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ lce hūm̐ las rdo rjer bskyed la/ oṃ a mṛ tod ka hūm̐ hūm̐ ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ trāṃ aṃ khaṃ hūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ lte bar gtum mo'i me'i dbus su lha thams cad kyi ngo bo hūm̐ bsams la/ lag pa dgang blugs kyis phul bar mos la g.yon pas longs spyad/ lhag ma uts+tshiṣ+ṭa'i sngags kyis 'byung po la sbyin/ khrus ni chu dbang gi cho gas bya/ nyal ba'i tshe snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdus la nyal/ ldang ba'i tshe dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i glu dang rol mos bskul bar mos la lhar ldang*/ dngos po thams cad bde mchog gi rnal 'byor du shes pa'i tshangs spyod la gnas pa dang*/ bla ma dang byang sems dang bdag nyid la rkang brgyad kyis mchod/ bde mchog gi nga rgyal dang ma bral bas rnam par mi rtog pa'i sems kyis dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyad par bya'o// de ltar 'bad pas mthar thug phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dang*/ gnas skabs phrin las bzhi sogs thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ 'chi ba'i tshe bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyis mkha' spyod du bsu bar gsungs so// gnyis pa dus bzang po dag la ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ zla ba yar mar gyi tshes bcu sogs la bab pa na/ gnas dben par dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mos pas don dam par sbyangs pa'i stegs bu'i steng du/

thig tshad dang ldan pa'i ras bris bkram pa'i mthar g.yon skor du chu bzhi nyer spyod lnga mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog bshams pa spyi mchod de dag gi nang*/ shar nub tu yab yum gyi spos/ mar me/ lha bshos/ de gnyis kyi rgyab dang lho byang du 'khor bzhi'i spos/ mar me/ lha bshos re re bshams pa sgos mchod rnams kyang g.yon skor/ de thams cad dur khrod kyi rdzas dang ldan par bya/ las sngags kyis bsangs/ gu gul gyis bdug /oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad gzhan yang tshogs par bya/ de nas bshad ma thag pa'i bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms rjes/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hes g.yon skor du bsangs/ shū n+ya tās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po zhes pa nas| mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can spros/ zla ba'i bar du zhugs pa las zhes pa nas/ dbang lha rnams gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ ces pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar gsal btab/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ gzugs mdzes yid 'ong lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// chags pa'i nyams ldan rmad byung bde ba ster// yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon snod 'dzin ma// mkha' khyab sprul pa'i lha mos mchod par bgyi// oṃ shrī tsakra sam+ba raṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gzugs mdzes yid 'ong lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// chags pa'i nyams ldan rmad byung bde ba ster// dri med chu gtsang zhabs bsil snod 'dzin ma// mkha' khyab sprul pa'i lha mos mchod par bgyi// oṃ shrī tsakra sam+ba raṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gzugs mdzes yid 'ong lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// chags pa'i nyams ldan rmad byung bde ba ster// dri bzang dang sbyar zhal bsil snod 'dzin ma// mkha' khyab sprul pa'i lha mos mchod par bgyi// oṃ shrī tsakra sam+ba raṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī ā tsa mā naṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

/mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i skur gsal ba// mi bskyod dbu rgyan can la phyag 'tshal bstod// spang bya spangs dang gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir// stag gi pags pa mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan// bdud bzhi 'joms phyir rno dkar mche ba gtsigs// thugs rjes 'dzum bcas khros la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ chos dbyings bde ba'i rang bzhin mchog /dngos po kun gyi bdag nyid can| |mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba sdom// he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhan skyes ye shes ngo bo nyid// zag med bde ba'i rang bzhin can// 'khor 'das dngos po kun gyi yum// rdo rje phag mor phyag 'tshal bstod// lus rjes dran dang dga' ba'i bdag /chu yi khams ni rnam dag pa// rdo rje rigs kyi yum gyur ma// mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// tshor ba rjes dran mchog dga'i dngos// rlung gi khams ni rnam dag pa// las kyi rigs kyi yum gyur ma// rab mdzes ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// chos rjes dran dang dga' bral nyid// me yi khams ni rnam dag pa// pad+ma'i rigs kyi yum gyur ma// dum skyes ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// sems rjes dran dang lhan skyes mchog /sa yi khams ni rnam dag pa| |rin chen rigs kyi yum gyur ma// gzugs can ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde gshegs bzhi yi ngo bo nyid// bdud rtsi'i bum par legs gnas pa'i// byang chub sems kyis gang ba yi// thod pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// byang chub phyogs rnams yongs rdzogs pa'i// bde chen thar pa mchog gi ni// gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal bstod// tshogs brgyad dag pa ye shes kyi// cho 'phrul las byung dur khrod dang*// gzung 'dzin rtog pas mi phyed pa'i// bsrung ba'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod la/ lha so so'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ la bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las lha tshogs spros/

'gro ba'i don byas slar yang hūm̐ la thim par gyur/ ces mos la/ sngags so so dang yig brgya ci 'grub bzla| de nas gtor ma gnyis sha chang sgog btsong gis brgyan pa bshams la/ bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ pheṃ/ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis durakhrod na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkha' spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs kyis mchod/ lag gnyis ā li kā li yongs su gyur pa las zla nyir gyur pa'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po dang bcas pa/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tā sarba dharmaḥpa ram+ba ra a nu pra wiṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmaḥ.ad+yan+ta a nu pra wiṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmaḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zla nyi sa bon yongs su gyur pa'i rdo rje thal mos gtor ma bteg par gyur/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste// bden pa 'di dag gis ni lha mo rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces brjod la/ mgron rnams kyi ljags 'od kyi rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bas bde stong gi ngo bor dgyes shing tshim par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ gsum brjod/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che| |sogs kyis bstod/ srid pa dang mnyam zhi ba'i chags bcom kun tu rtog pa 'joms// khyod ni dngos po mtha' dag mkha' ltar gzigs pa dag dang ldan// mgon po shin tu brtse ba lci ba'i chus brlan thugs kyi chu// mdzod cig lha mo rnams ni bdag la shin tu rjes brtser mdzod// ces 'dod don gsol/ 'jig rten pa rnams skad cig gis bde mchog yab yum du gyur pa'i ljags 'od kyis sogs dang*/ oṃ kha kha sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/

gong ltar mchod cing bstod la/ lha yi tshogs sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ yig brgya brjod/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsogs brjod cing pad kor 'khyud tshul dang se gol bya zhing*/ oṃ/ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsams la nye reg bya/ bdag 'jug mi len na/ dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin stsol cig gi bar brjod la skabs 'dir tshogs 'khor bya/ rjes chog shis brjod kyi bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o// gsum pa bdag dang slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang gi rim pa ni/ tshad dang ldan pa'i bum pa gnyis dkar por byas la/ gu gul gyis bdug /las sngags dang hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags bzla zhing yungs dkar gyis brab/ mgul chings ze prog gsum pa bya/ rnam rgyal la chos 'byung gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po'i lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ las bum la pad nyi'i dbus su gri gug gi lte bar pāṃ bris pa btags/ rta glang bong bus ma brgal zhing srog chags med pa'i chus sum gnyis bkang*/ bum rdzas so lnga blugs/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan/ hūm̐ bdun bzlas pa'i srad bu lngas dkri zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra shi kha ra ru ṭa ma ṭa di shaṃ bhan+dha hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ rnam rgyal shar sgo'i g.yas dang las bum g.yon du rdor ra'i nang du ku sha'i gdan la bkod/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐/ lan bdun bzlas pa'i dung chen ni dung chos sam nya phyis dri chus bkang ba rnam rgyal gyi khar bzhag pa'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gi phreng ba btags pa bkod la de gnyis bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te swā hā/ zhes pas lha'i chu bo gaṅgā drangs pa bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du bum mtshan pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/

don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i sku can zhes pa nas/ thod pa dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur gyi bar dang*/ las bum gyi nang dang bum mtshan pad nyi'i gdan la pāṃ las gri gug pāṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las dum skyes ma dmar mo/ zhal gcig /spyan gsum/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ sogs nas/ ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ nas| mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang dum skyes ma la rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan dbang lha rnams gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ ces pa'i bar brjod la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ gdod ma'i 'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa las// rang rtsal rdo rje'i lha mo mchod yon ma// rang snang bum pa'i lha tshogs rnams la dbul// rnam gsum yongs dag don gyis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil sogs dang so so'i sngags bcas dang*/ pi wang ma dang gling bu ma sogs kyis kyang mchod/ oṃ/ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal| |bskal pa chen po mtha' yi me lta bu// ral pa'i tshogs kyi cod pan bcings pa ste// mche gtsigs drag cing 'jigs su rung ba'i zhal// phyag ni 'od zer stong phrag 'bar ba po| |dgra sta zhags 'phyar mdung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin// stag gi pags pa'i na bza' 'phyang bar mdzad// du ba mun chen mdog mtshungs sku la 'dud// oṃ/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo la ni phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags ma 'jig rten gsum yum gzhan gyis mi thub rig pa'i dbang phyug che// 'byung po thams cad 'jigs mdzad kun tu 'bebs ma rdo rje chen mo nyid// rdo rje gdan ma mi pham gzhan gyis mi thub dbang mdzad g.yo ba'i spyan// dug kyang skem par mdzad ma 'jigs su rung pa'i khro mo gtsigs byed mo// skrag byed gsod byed rab tu 'byed cing pha rol las rgyal ma// rnam par rgyal ma rmugs par mdzad cing rengs dang rmongs par mdzad pa mo// rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// chos dbyings bde ba'i rang bzhin mchog

/sogs dang*/ dbang gi las dang dga' bral dang*// chos rjes dran pa'i ngo bo nyid// sku mdog dmar mo drag shul can// khaṇ+ḍa ro he la phyag 'tshal// zhes bstod la/ hūm̐ zhes gzung thag la 'jus te/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags phreng spros pa gzung thag la 'khril te song bas bum nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul bas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pa dang*/ sngags kyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug pas bum pa gang bar gyur par mos te/ yab yum gyi sngags brgya phrag sogs dang*/ 'khor la nyer gcig sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka ham̐'u/ brgya phrag bzla/ gzung thag las bum gyi khar spos la las sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ gtso las thun mong du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdun dang yig brgya bzla| nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra ti'ats+tsha hūm̐ gis rnam rgyal du mchod yon dang*/ hūm̐ bdun bzlas pa'i me tog dkar pos mchod nas/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha rnams chags pa chen pos byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu ba bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ las bum gyi lhas ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba rnams ma rdzogs kyi bar bgegs rnams zlog par mdzod cig /las sngags brjod cing las chu gtor la bum pa gnyis bsrung*/ gtor ma btang la nye reg byas nas/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi nga rgyal gyis/ oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs brjod cing me tog bzung*/ rdo rje'i shugs kyis 'jug pas dkyil 'khor du zhugs par mos shing g.yon du bskor la/ shar nas/ oṃ/ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan// sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhi hi hi hi hi/ mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol// pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes gtso bo la me tog phul/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi rgyas/ oṃ badz+roṅghā ṭa sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐/

lan bzhis sgo nang nas phye bar bsam zhing*/ sngar phul pa'i me tog mgor bcings/ deng sems can thams cad la dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin stsol cig /ces brjod/ de nas bdag 'jug pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos slob dpon dang rang gis slob ma'i bya ba byas la/ las chus bkru phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul thal mo sbyar te/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ oṃ tsak+ṣurbahan+dha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐ gis mig dar/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog bzung*/ las chus bsangs/ rang nyid 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i spyi bor zla ba la oṃ/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥ snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od kyis lus 'od gsal bar gyur par mos/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// zhes dri/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// zhes lan bya/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs kyis thun mong gi sdom pa gzung*/ rang gi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba nya gang ba'i dbus su don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed/ de nyid brtan phyir me tog dang bcas snying gar reg la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol| |bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por bdag gis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas bdag gis gzung*| |rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi| |dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rig chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du so sor gzung*// mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gi bskyed par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral| |ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces gsum gyis thun mong min pa'i sdom pa gzung*/

deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyi/ khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing*/ ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// zhes gsang bar gdams/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ gis nang du bcug par mos/ oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ na maḥmi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes phyag bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// zhes bla mas brjod/ rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ deng ngas khyod la rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis kyang 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ rdo rje snying gar bzung la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// dung zhal gyi chu sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ rdo rje lag tu gtad la/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par shi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/

zhes phan yon dang nyes dmigs gnyis ka dang slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'o// dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bdag la dbab tu gsol/ gsum gsol/ rang 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i rkang mthil du laṃ/ lte bar aṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ mgrin par oṃ/ spyi bo haṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ yaṃ las rlung g.yos pas lte ba'i aṃ las me 'bar snying ga'i hūm̐ dang*/ mgrin pa'i oṃ bsregs/ spyi bo'i haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab lus thams cad zag med kyi bde bas khyab gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad spyan drangs nas rang gi ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas zhugs shing thim par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ badz+ra ma hā kro dha dz+nyā na ā we sha ya a aḥhrīḥbaṃ hūm̐/ zhes mang du brjod cing rol mo byas la byin dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis brtan par bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi kha dog brtags la lung bstan/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma bcug pa 'di'i// lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni// bsod nams ji lta de ltar shog /'di yi dngos grub ji 'drar 'gyur// bsod nams mthu yang ji 'dra ba// de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /ces bla mas brjod/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes me tog dor/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes me tog de rang gi mgor bcing*/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes mig phye/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*// grub kun khyod la mngon du 'gyur// dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// sngags kyi dngos grub sgrub par gyis// zhes dkyil 'khor bstan par bsam mo// de nas dbang dngos la/

rig dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas bstsal// de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /gsum brjod/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la rang dang*/ bum chu hūm̐ dang rdo rje las mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med cing dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba bum pa'i chur gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ yum lngas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ */khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ */sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ tsakra bī ra s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ bum chu spyi bor blugs/ zhes dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag /mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ des mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang gi dri ma dag /rnam shes kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// zhes mos/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la rang dang*/ dbu rgyan aṃ dang rin po che las rin 'byung ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing phyag rgya lngas spras pa/

gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med cing dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba dbu rgyan du gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ yum lngas bum pa dang dbu rgyan bsnams nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che// rin chen 'byung gnas mchog 'gro ba// rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes dbu rgyan bskon/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ zhes dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag /rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ des rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma dag /tshor ba'i phung po gnas 'gyur/ mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// zhes mos/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la rang dang*/ rdo rje dz+rīṃ dang pad+ma las 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med cing dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba rdo rjer gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ yum lngas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang rdo rje bsnams nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi// dbang gi de ring khyod dbang bskur// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid| |rab tu grub phyir rdo rje zung*// oṃ āḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rdo rje snying mgrin dpral bar reg cing smin mtshams su gsor la snying gar bzung*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ zhes dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag /'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ des 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag /'du shes kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ sor rtog ye shes mngon du byas/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// zhes mos/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la rang dang*/ dril bu khaṃ dang ral gri las don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med cing dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba dril bur gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ yum lngas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang dril bu bsnams nas/

oṃ/ dril bu shes rab rab ldan pas// shin tu dpa' bo nyid dbang bskur// rdo rje'i dam tshig gnas pa khyod// bdag po'i dbang bskur rgyal nos shig /oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dril bu mgor bzhag smin mtshams su dkrol zhing dkur brten/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ zhes dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag /don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs kyis mchod/ des don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang thob// phrag dog gi dri ma dag /'du byed kyi phung po'i gnas 'gyur/ bya grub ye shes mngon du byas// las kyi rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo*// zhes mos/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la rang dang*/ buṃ dang 'khor lo las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med cing dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba bum pa dang rdor dril du gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ yum lngas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang rdor dril spyi bor mnyam par bsnams nas/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// rtag pa'i rdo rjer rab zhugs te// mi shigs rdo rje'i ming ldan pas// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro// oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/

shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal chen rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes rdor dril mnyam du spyi bor bzung la dkrol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ zhes dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag /rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod| des rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug gi dri ma dag /gzugs kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas// de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang*/ des ma rig pa'i gnyen po nus pa nyid du bsgrubs pas na rig pa'i dbang zhes bya'o// rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba// mgon pos bdag la bstsal nas ni// 'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon phrin las yongs su gsungs// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa'ang bla med bstsal du gsol// gsum gsol/ rang nyid hūm̐ dang rdo rje las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog sngon po yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba gsal bar gyur/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje// oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa aḥ zhes rdor dril gyi de nyid kyis bzung nas gsor zhing dkrol/ yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir| |phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod// gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan// des na phyag rgyar rab tu grags// ye shes phyag rgyar byin brlabs nas// 'dod pa thams cad longs spyad de| |dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya// zhes 'khyud tshul bya/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod// yid rig la 'khyud pa'i reg bde stong nyid dang zung du 'jug pa rang rig pa'i ye shes gang yin pa de ni slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo yin no// zhes ngo sprad/

rdo rje che dang dril bu che| |zung zhig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs ni bsdu bar gyis// zhes brjod/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ yum lngas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par gyur// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ bum chu spyi bor blug /zhes dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag /mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ thar pa chen po'i pho brang rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dur khrod rdo ra me ri dang bcas pa 'di rang gi sems kyi dkyil 'khor yin la/ sems nyid kyi rtogs pa'i yon tan mi 'dra ba las/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun du shar ba mtshon pa ni sgo dang rgyan la sogs par snang ba dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid dang*/ sems nyid phung khams skye mched du shar ba'i rang bzhin bcom ldan 'das yab yum stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med pa de'i gsal snang ma 'gag pa las mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi ste lha'i de nyid do// khyod kyis 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor 'bri zhing sgrub pa dang*/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba dang*/ rab gnas dang sbyin sreg la sogs pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi las dang bya ba'i rim pa 'khor dang bcas pa la dbang ba yin no// zhes de nyid bstan cing las rim bshad/

sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes che// dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol// gsum gsol/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung ba zhal nas thon rang gi rna ba g.yas nas zhugs snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim par gyur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// snying po yi ni yi ge mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdus pa ni// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// zhes sngags rnams lan gsum bzla/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol| |zhes dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes sngags dbang dang*/ rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi hiḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje smin mtshams su gsor zhing snying gar bzung ba rdo rje'i brtul zhugs/ rang dang dbang rdzas he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba dbang rdzas so so'i rnam par gyur/ ces gnas so sor byin la/ kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u lhung bzed dag /dpa' bos byin pa blangs nas ni// he ru ka yi phyag rgya 'di// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lha'i sku bde ba chen po/ ḍā ma ru shes rab stong pa nyid/ thod pa de gnyis 'dus pas bde ba skyong ba/ tshangs skud rnam par mi rtog pa'i don yin no// zhes spyod pa'i brtul zhugs so// deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis// gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs// 'dod yon lnga la spyod par gyis// deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis// lus dang srog la mi lta bar// rten cing 'brel ba 'byung ba'i chos// 'gro ba'i don ni dpag med byos// zhes lung bstan dang*/

bla ma sprul sku'i rnam pas/ oṃ/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid dang ngan 'gro rnams las bton// kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sid+dhiḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ bhurbahu waḥswaḥ zhes lung bstan/ khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud tshogs kun las rnam rgyal zhing*// pho brang mchog tu zhugs pa yin// zhes dbugs dbyung*/ des bris pa'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang kun thob/ lus rtsa'i sgrib pa dag /lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku sgrub pa'i skal pa can du byas so| |gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar// bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol// ces gsol ba btab/ gdong bcings/ yid las byung ba'i rig ma rdo rje phag mor gsal ba gtso bo la phul bas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi sangs rgyas thams cad zhu ba'i ngo bos dbang bskur/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis// ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur// byang chub sems ni bzang po yis// de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur bgyi// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces byin par mos la bdud rtsi btung zhing*/ a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ byang sems de nyid myangs pas bde ba dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes pa ni gsang dbang gi ngo bo yin no// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bsal/ bha ga la lta bar bsams la bde ba bskyed/ des bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag rlung gi dri ma dag |lam rang byin rlabs kyi rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas so// sher dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal dang gsol gdab gong ltar byas la gdong bcings/

bla mas/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// zhes ye shes kyi rig ma byin/ des kyang*/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan// gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa// de yi mdun na bdag gnas so// sangs rgyas bstan pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ci bzhin gyis// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes pang du byon par bsam/ rang 'khor lo sdom pa dang rig ma rdo rje phag mor gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las zhes pa nas/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par bab pa dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'| lte bar khyad dga'/ nor bu'i rtse mor son pas lhan skyes kyi dga' ba nyams su myong bar gyur/ hūm̐ zhes gyen du drangs/ de'i tshe bde stong zung 'jug rjes chags dpe'i ye shes rgyud la skye ba sher dbang gi ngo bo yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ gdong g.yogs bsal/ des kun rdzob byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid thig le'i dri ma dag /lam nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas so// dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyang du gsol// gsum dang*/ bla mas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis phyag rgya dang gnyis sprad pa la brten nas myong ba snang ba thob pa'i shes pa de 'od gsal bar sgoms shig /de ni rnam par shes pa gsum rnam par dag pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid lus dang ngag dang sems med pa/ las dang skye ba las grol ba/ zla ba dang*/ nyi ma dang*/

me dang*/ nor bu ltar shin tu gsal ba/ rtag tu snang ba'i mtshan nyid can don dam pa'i bden pa de ni mthong ba gzhan gyi yul las 'das pa ste/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi mig gis ltos shig /de ltar gang gi yang rang bzhin du ma mthong ba de 'od gsal ba mthong ba yin no// de ltar 'od gsal ba de'i ngo na rgyu 'bras gang yang med mod kyi/ 'on kyang kun rdzob tu rlung dang sems tsam las lha lnga me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal la rdzogs pa 'ja' tshon ltar kha dog dang bcas pa/ chu zla ltar sgro skur dang bral bar ltos shig /de ni rgyu rkyen la ltos nas skyes pas kun rdzob bo// de ltar bden pa gnyis de/ gnyis mi byed par zung du 'jug pa ni byang chub kyi sems chen po ste bzhi pa'o| |zhes ngo sprad/ 'di ni rang nyid mdzes ma ste// phyi rol yul ni spangs pa'o// rigs 'di bor nas de las ni// gzhan pa'i thabs kyis sangs rgyas med// rig ma'i brtul zhugs spyod cig bu// brtul zhugs rnams kyi bla ma'i bla// mtshan med bsam gyis mi khyab pa// 'di la rtag tu gnas par gyis// zhes rig ma'i brtul zhugs byin/ des don dam byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma gzung 'dzin dang bcas pa dag /lam phyag rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*| 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas so// maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bden pa'i byin rlabs ni rdor dril dang bcas/ sems can kun gyi snying la zhugs// sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid| |'dod mchog dam tshig mchog gyur pa'i// bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor yin// bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis// bdag gi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod// ces brjod/ de nas lag mchod bya bar 'dod na/ lag g.yon pa'i mthil du nang mchod kyis gtor zhing las sngags kyis bsangs la/

thig le dbus su gcig dang mthar lnga/ sor mo lnga dang sen mo bsdus par thig le re re bya zhing*/ lag mthil pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar oṃ baṃ/ mdun nas g.yon skor du/ haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hrīṃ/ huṃ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ mthe bong sogs lnga dang sen mo bsdus par oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣaṭa he/ huṃ hūm̐ hoḥ phaṭa haṃ rnams go cha'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i ngo bo/ bol du bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal ba'i khams lnga lha mo lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ nyer spyod lnga dang*/ so so'i sngags kyis sha zan sbrags pa re dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi dbul/ rkang brgyad dam he ru ka dpal sogs kyis bstod/ rdzas rnams tshogs rdzas la bsre/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lag pa'i lha rnams rang la thim par gyur/ ces mos/ tshogs 'khor byed na thabs shes kyi rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi 'thor zhing nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐ */ spyi bo bde chen pho brang nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// gar bzhugs dag pa'i pho brang nas// brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa'i tshogs// 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// bcom ldan 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas// dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo'i tshogs// dur khrod rngam brjid 'bar ba nas// bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas// snying po'i bstan srung sna nam bza'// rnal 'byor gdung bas spyan 'dren na// thugs rje chen pos brtser dgongs la// dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs nas kyang*// sa gzhi bkra shis mdzad du gsol// kye/ tshogs khang pho brang gzhal yas 'di// o rgyan gnas su byin gyis rlobs// tshogs mgron dpa' bo dpa' mo dang*// snod rnams mtshan ldan ka pā la// 'dod yon longs spyod sna tshogs rnams// ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ha hoḥhrīḥs// kha dog dri ro phun tshogs zhing*/ */sbyangs rtogs sbar zhing spel ba yis// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// bcom ldan 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog

/yi dam rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskor// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas// bstan pa srung ba'i chos skyong sogs// srid zhis bsdus pa'i mgron rnams la// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// bdag cag 'dir 'dus thams cad kyi// sgo gsum phung khams skye mched la// byin gyis brlabs par mdzad nas kyang*// sku gsum go 'phang thob mdzad gsol// de nyid ma thob bar du yang*// phyi nang bar gcod mi 'byung zhing*// bsam don 'bad med 'grub pa dang*// mchog thun dngos grub bstsal du gsol| |zhes tshogs phud phul/ gtor bsngos kyi rim pa rgyas par bya/ tshogs spros la slob dpon rnams la drangs/ spro na zhus len yang bya/ bag dang ldan pas longs spyad/ rnam lnga 'dod kor dang bcas rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol// rnal 'byor ma tshogs pad+ma'i bde// a la la la la la hoḥ /dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba'i mchog /rnal 'byor ma tshogs mchod par mdzod// a ī ā ā ra li hoḥ /rab dgyes mgon po dgyes bzhugs mdzod// mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde ba gsol// dgyes pa'i bde ba gsol bar mdzod// zhi ba'i gar gyis gar mdzad pa// bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol// thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod// a la la la la la hoḥ */bde ba spangs pas grol mi 'gyur// bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol// bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas// chags pa'i dngos pos khyod ma bsgyur// bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod// pad+ma rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis// bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod// ces brjod/ lhag ma bsdus par a kā ros byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐ */ khrag 'thung bka' nyan lhag ma'i bdag /gnas zhing sngags skyes dpa' bo dang*// mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro phyogs skyong dang*// zhing skyong sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs// sha za las dang 'jig rten gyi// pho nya sde 'khor 'bum dang bcas// gzugs dang cha lugs ma nges shing*// rdo rje'i rkang stabs dkyil 'khor bskor// brda dang brda len glu gar sgyur// rnal 'byor drod nyul lhag ma len// 'dir gshegs dpal gyi pha 'bab bzhes// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod cing*// phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang*/

phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod// oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes dbul/ de nas rjes kyi bya ba ni/ bum mdun la mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas la/ dge ba 'di yis sogs dang*/ sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni he ru kar gyur cing*// sems can thams cad he ru ka'i// go 'phang mchog la 'god gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdig med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad gyur pa'i// lam de nyid la 'jug par shog /bde ba phun tshogs yang dag ldan// nad med dge ba'i sems dang ni// 'dod dang thar sogs yang dag thob// phun sum tshogs pa 'grub gyur cig /ma bsgral bsgral dang ma grol dgrol// dbugs dbyung mya ngan 'das 'god cing*// rnal 'byor gtsug lag dam tshig la| |da lta nyid du gnas par shog /ces sogs kyis smon lam btab/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa| su poṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko3bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yig brgya gsum dang*/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pas// de kun mgon khyod bzod par gsol| |gtso bo nus pa ma mchis shing*// ma rnyed pa dang ma tshang ba// 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa// de kun mgon khyod bzod par gsol// so so'i skye bor gyur gang dang*// rnal 'byor ma thob dbang gis dang*// nye bar mkho ba med pa dang*// brjed dang shes bzhin ma yin pas// cung zhig cho ga nyer ma tshang*// de dag bkru zhing bzod par gsol// zhes nong pa bshags| oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ bum mdun gyi ye shes pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/

dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim par gyur par bsam mo// rdo rje 'chang dbang klu sgrub dril zhabs sogs| |dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa la// byin rlabs rmad byung dge legs mnga' ba'i mthus// bde ba chen po'i bkra shis 'phel gyur cig /rgyal kun skyed mdzad rdo rje btsun mo'i mkhar// dgyes dgu'i gar mdzad bcom ldan he ru kaḥ /spangs rtogs rmad byung dge legs mnga' ba'i mthus// bde ba chen po'i bkra shis 'phel gyur cig |zag med dga' ba bzhi yi rang bzhin can// bde chen 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma rnams la// srid zhi'i dge legs mtha' yas mnga' ba'i mthus// bde ba chen po'i bkra shis 'phel gyur cig /pho brang rab mdzes thar pa chen po'i grong*// srung 'khor dur khrod bkod pa kun ldan pa// rmad byung dge legs ji snyed mnga' ba'i mthus// bde ba chen po'i bkra shis 'phel gyur cig /mthu chen bstan pa srung ba'i chos skyong rnams// sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin// log 'dren tshar gcod bsam don kun sgrub cing*// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dge legs stsol// ces sogs shis pa brjod/ dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// smras pa/ sdom pa'i gzhung bzang rgyas dang bsdus pa sogs// ji snyed mchis la mchog dman dbye ba ci// bod rnams rang gis nyams su ma blang pas// dngos grub ma mchis de dag sgrub dkyil gyi// rgyas bsdus tshig sbyor dag la re zhing 'khang*// rang rang blo dang 'tsham pa'i man ngag la// gces par bzung nas nyams len mthar bskyangs na// dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par gdon mi za// snyigs dus rkyen mang tshe thung longs spyod dbul// thal phyir tha snyad rtog ge'i chos kyis bslu// de bas theg mchog lam 'dir 'bad byas na// blo gros 'dun ma legs par kho bos sems// rig 'dzin bye ba phrag brgya gshegs pa'i shul|

|'khor lo sdom pa'i lam bzang 'dir 'jug pa// brgya phrag bsod nams zong gis bsgrubs pa yi// dal ba thob pa don dang ldan par nges// rab dkar dge ba 'di dang gzhan// ji snyed mchis kun khams gsum pa'i// 'gro la ris med bsngos zin gyi/ /kun kyang bde ba mchog thob shog /de ltar 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub dkyil mdor bsdus pa snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ sgrub sde rin chen brag tu rgyas par spel ba'i slad du de nyid kyi gdan sa ba mched grogs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba sid+dhi rastu/ 'di dag gi lag len go don sogs mtha' gcod rgyas pa kho bos bgyis pa'i bde mchog gi yig cha mang du yod pa las rtogs par byos shig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
